Messages.Author: Andrew Rowanbranch
Messages.Body:
Are all strikes based on a "strength + X" effect hand strikes? I was
wondering since, for example Burning Wrath has always been seen as a
seperate strike in our area, not counting as a Hand Strike?

A wording found in another post defining a hand strike:
a non ranged, non weapon strike, based on the user's strength.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Andrew Rowanbranch wrote:
>
> Are all strikes based on a "strength + X" effect hand strikes? I was
> wondering since, for example Burning Wrath has always been seen as a
> seperate strike in our area, not counting as a Hand Strike?

From the online rulings (http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulings.html):

Hand Strike: any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals damage based
on the striking minion's strength, or any minion's non-ranged
damage-dealing innate strike.

(The part after the comma is superfluous with current card texts on
allies, but is true nonetheless).

Burning Wrath is a hand strike.

> A wording found in another post defining a hand strike:
> a non ranged, non weapon strike, based on the user's strength.

This is a correct restatement of the official definition, yes.
